lines.en: Hi, Max. Can I help you find something?
lines.pt: Oi, Max. Posso ajudar a encontrar alguma coisa?

lines.en: Yes. This jacket was on sale last week. What happened to the sale?
lines.pt: Sim. Esta jaqueta estava em promoção semana passada. O que aconteceu com a promoção?

lines.en: The sale ended on Sunday. The jackets were reduced by thirty percent.
lines.pt: A promoção acabou no domingo. As jaquetas foram reduzidas em trinta por cento.

lines.en: That is a pity. I was here on Saturday, but the store was very full.
lines.pt: Que pena. Eu estive aqui no sábado, mas a loja estava muito cheia.

lines.en: Yes, it was crowded. Many customers were waiting to pay.
lines.pt: Sim, estava lotada. Muitos clientes esperavam para pagar.

lines.en: The price was fifty dollars then. Now it is seventy. That is a big change.
lines.pt: O preço era cinquenta dólares. Agora é setenta. É uma grande mudança.

lines.en: I know. The original price was eighty, and it was reduced twice.
lines.pt: Eu sei. O preço original era oitenta, e foi reduzido duas vezes.

lines.en: Was the red one on sale too, or only the black one?
lines.pt: O vermelho também estava em promoção, ou só o preto?

lines.en: Both were on sale. The red one was sold out by Sunday morning.
lines.pt: Os dois estavam. O vermelho foi vendido até domingo de manhã.

lines.en: Really? Then maybe I can ask for a small discount today.
lines.pt: Sério? Então talvez eu possa pedir um pequeno desconto hoje.

lines.en: Let me ask my manager. Last month she gave a discount to a friend.
lines.pt: Vou perguntar à minha gerente. No mês passado ela deu desconto a um amigo.

facts.big: It was on sale last week
facts.label: Falar de promoção no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + on sale ou reduced: It was on sale. They were reduced by thirty percent. Use last week, on Sunday, yesterday para dizer quando.

facts.label: Estava(m) em promoção
facts.sub: Use was para uma coisa e were para várias: The jacket was on sale. The shoes were on sale. Para a pergunta, inverta: Was it on sale? Were they on sale last week?

facts.label: Reduzido em…
facts.sub: Use was/were reduced + by + porcentagem: It was reduced by twenty percent. Use to para o preço final: It was reduced to fifty dollars. A diferença é pequena, mas importante.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Was on sale means the price was lower.
Reduced means the price went up.
items.why: Reduced means the price went down.

items.s: We say “It was reduced by thirty percent.”
items.why: This is a passive sentence in the past.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Was on sale means the price was lower. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Reduced means the price went up. → Falso (Reduced means the price went down.)
We say “It was reduced by thirty percent.” → Verdadeiro (This is a passive sentence in the past.)

pages.title: A clothing store in Chicago · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy Tuesday in Chicago. Max walks into a clothing store near his office. He saw a jacket in the window last week. Then it was on sale, but he was too busy to buy it. Dean works at the store and knows the prices well. Max wants to know what happened.

“Hi, Max. Can I help you find something?” says Dean. “Yes. This jacket was on sale last week. What happened to the sale?” says Max. “The sale ended on Sunday. The jackets were reduced by thirty percent.” says Dean.
